claims.claim: Exact discrete frozen two-input negative-correlation mixed-cone entrance selector, including open overshoot discrepancy from continuous entrance.

Conditional on R1<0<R2, actual critical-step GD has selected global fixed-horizon output law r=exp(-Qt)R, Q=C+diag(P1,P2); L1 and positive-time uniform pre-step Gram convergence. Two unit inputs, -1<rho<0, fixed gamma>0, iid symmetric alpha-stable original coordinates, shallow network.
For rho=-.5 and gamma 1 versus .1, same-initialization fixed-time output separation has positive limiting probability.
For rho=-.5, gamma 1 and .1 have distinct selected conditional path laws and disjoint sets of unconditioned subsequential output path laws; unconditioned full convergence not asserted.
Conditional independent Levy-thinned selected masses; finite-gamma masses nonstable; almost-sure iterated gamma→0 and gamma→infinity limits; nested-grid ordering.
The same mark selector is monotone in every real gamma, or always equals the continuous entrance selector.
General residual-dependent nonorthogonal sliding/exit selection, full T384 deep training, simultaneous gamma_m→0 limit, test predictions.
External priority and native ingestion confirmation.
